description: Python and R code that builds the SHARE and HRS analytic cohorts, fits Cox models with age as the time scale and delayed entry, re-estimates onset contrasts under three follow-up rules and within shared age windows, and reproduces the figures and tables of the manuscript. Version 1.1.3 updates the README version statement; the analysis code is unchanged from 1.1.2. Version 1.1.2 stores model estimates at full precision so that the manuscript rounds once at display time; version 1.1.1 made the pipeline portable (POSIX and Windows path handling, AGING_DB_OUT honoured throughout), aligned the follow-up rule labels with the paper, and added a pipeline and dependency guide. Participant-level data are not included.
